name: Abhinav Manoj
description: SatQuery AI is an agentic vision-language assistant for multimodal satellite remote-sensing analysis through natural-language queries. Developed for ISRO (SIH26167), it orchestrates specialist models—ViT-Base, ResNet-18, PaliGemma, InternVL2, and Qwen2-VL—across Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 optical imagery. It supports land-cover classification, visual question answering (VQA), spatial grounding with bounding boxes, bi-temporal change detection, and automated intelligence dossiers through an interactive workspace.
